Principal Responsibilities
- Handle all trade finance transactions for DBS clients including OA Finance and Draft transactions
处理星展银行客户的所有应收应付融资业务和票据融资业务。
- Support bank’s project management of the trade service product processing optimization, especially AI projects UR analysis, design, testing & launch
支持银行贸易服务产品及流程及系统优化项目，重点支持AI项目相关的需求分析、设计测试，上线等环节。
- Backup handle import & export L/Cs, DA/DP, bank guarantee and relevant finances for DBS clients.
候补处理星展客户的国际贸易融资业务包括银行保函，进出口信用证，托收以及相关融资业务.
- Check supporting docs according to bank’s guidance/trade finance procedure and ensure applications compliance with internal control requirement as well as compliance requirement.
根据银行的操作指引以及贸易融资的操作流程审核相关证明文 ，以确保交易申请符合银行内控和合规要求。
- Checking trade finance documents according to UCP/URDG/ISBP/URR and other international trade finance practice.
根据相关国际惯例审核贸易融资单据.
- Booking trade finance and relevant funds disbursement in banking system and make data information verification. Process cash margin, BAD/CAD pledge on transactional basis.
将相关贸易融资以及资金的转移收付录入银行系统并确保数据准确性, 根据流程处理交易层面的客户保证金和质押票据的收付.
- Conduct post checking/monitoring of trade related supporting documents which shall be align with “3 measures & 1 guideline”.
根据”3个办法一个指引” 的要求进行贷后文件的跟踪和审核.
- Handle DBS client inquiry on trade finance related transactions.
处理星展客户关于贸易融资业务的查询/咨询.
- Make sure any deviations/irregulars were raised to Team head, and obtain proper DOA approval on exceptions.
确保任何异常交易被上报给部门主管，并且在处理异例前得到相应的授权。
- Conduct regulatory, MIS and other internal/external reporting for trade finance business i.e.SAFE/UPRR/RCPMIS/FTZMIS etc.
及时提交对内对外相关报表.
- Assist team head to improve/maintain internal and external audit score, and make sure no significant finding during assessment.
协助部门主管/经理共同达到集团内部审计和外部审计的评定要求，并在规定时间内完成整改要求。
- Participate in bank’s training if necessary.
积极参与银行相关培训.

Education and Relevant Experience
- Bachelor degree holder or above.
- CDCS certificate/CSDG certificate
- Minimum 5 years’ experience in Trade Finance operations including OA Finance, Draft and Import/export Trade Finance.
Functional / Technical Competencies
- Good knowledge on Trade Finance and related rules, regulation and practice,
- In-depth knowledge on trade related international rules, regulations and practices
- Basic knowledge of accounting
- Proficient in commonly used data analysis software e.g., Excel, SQL, Tableau, Power BI, R, Python, etc.
- Good data visualization skills: Ability to create clear, concise, and insightful charts and reports
- Good PC skills and good command of English and Mandarin.
- Good communication skill and problem solving skill.
- Capable to work effectively under pressure and tight deadline

Location:

PRC - Shanghai

Job:

Operations

Schedule:

Regular

Employee Status:

Full time

职位目标

  • 借助行内各种渠道,进行新客户开发,参与行内外组织的客户推介活动,积累客户资源。
  • 为支行或分行营业部新客户提供客户开户服务和维护,日常咨询方面的需求,增加客户在我行的资产占比,以达到银行预期的业务和服务目标。
  • 发展成为银行的丰盛理财经理储备人才。

主要职责

  • 渠道开发和拓展合格丰盛理财客户
  • 开拓挖掘新客户获取渠道（如战略合作伙伴，客户推荐，行内活动等），为我行新增合格丰盛理财客户。
  • 维护和优化现有渠道质量，主动探索深化与渠道合作伙伴关系，在拓展新客工作中实现高效协同。
  • 负责新客户开发的全流程：对潜在客户进行定向触达和资质筛选，为新客户开立账户，完成申请和相关文档。
  • 达成银行下达的各项销售任务，达到销售目标，为团队整体增长指标做出贡献。
  • 协作式客户关系管
  • 与客户经理紧密合作，与潜在客户积极互动，主动收集客户洞察（如风险偏好，财务目标等），确保客户交接顺畅和持续支持。
  • 向客户引介我行全球财富管理解决方案，突出贴合其财务目标的价值主张。
  • 主动处理和跟进客户的要求和查询，按照银行服务标准提供及时有效的解决方案，维持良好的客户满意度和留存率。
  • 审计和合规控制
  • 遵守银行的政策、标准、操作准则/规程、安保及内部控制和合规措施，尤其是分支机构当地的操作规程。
  • 遵守由当地监管机构做出的规则和规定，尤其是那些适用于销售过程的规则和规定。

职责管辖范畴

  • 丰盛理财客户拓展经理向丰盛理财客户拓展主管汇报，并需负责达到和超越本行所分配之各项销售指标。

教育背景和相关工作经验要求

教育经历

  • 拥有正规学历，商务或财务相关专业优先考虑。
  • 对外资银行工作抱有热忱。

工作经验

有相关销售经验和客户开发经验者优先。

专业技能要求

  • 技术知识: 具备主动高效的客户沟通技巧，擅长通过专业化，场景化沟通话术。
  • 多重任务: 能够驾驭多个优先事务，保持敏锐的关注和精力水平，管理时间，以获得积极的成果。
  • 产品知识: 具备银行有关产品和服务知识者优先。

Location:

PRC - Beijing

Job:

Product Sales

Schedule:

Regular

Employee Status:

Full time

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Manager - DACRM.

Principal responsibilities

  • Analyse large volumes of structured and unstructured data to generate insights and recommendations across risk and operations (Fraud, Collections, Underwriting, KYC).
  • Apply advanced statistical techniques, predictive modelling and AI/ML methods to develop practical, scalable solutions.
  • Proactively identify emerging business issues and priorities, and translate them into analytics use cases with clear methodology and measurable outcomes.
  • Manage end-to-end delivery of analytics initiatives, including solution design, validation, performance tracking and impact assessment.
  • Deliver high-quality outputs on time in a fast-changing environment, balancing rigour with pace.
  • Collaborate with business, operations and technology teams to implement analytics/AI solutions and define performance measurement frameworks.
  • Share knowledge and best practices, contributing to a collaborative, inclusive and supportive team culture.

Requirements

  • University degree (or above) in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data/Information Management, or a related discipline.
  • Strong track record of extracting insights from large datasets and applying machine learning/AI techniques effectively.
  • Hands-on experience with Python, SQL/BigQuery, and visualisation tools (Tableau or QlikSense); experience working in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) is required.
  • Experience in risk-related domains (e.g., Fraud, Collections, Underwriting, KYC) is an advantage.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex analysis clearly to varied audiences and influence decisions.
  • Proven ability to work effectively across business, operations and technology stakeholders.
  • High ownership mindset and strong service orientation, focused on improving customer communication and service delivery.

Candidate with less relevant experience or skills may be offered a lower Global Career Band than stated above.

Due to the urgent hiring need, candidates with immediate right to work locally and no relocation need will be prioritised.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Some careers have more impact than others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Vice President, Ops Support.

Principal responsibilities

Set direction and govern the Ops Support agenda (AI-first + simplification + performance)

  • Own and drive the RBWS Ops Support priorities aligned to Hong Kong Operations strategy: AI-first operating model adoption, process/policy simplification, and sustained operational performance uplift.
  • Build and maintain a prioritized portfolio of initiatives with clear outcomes, sequencing, dependencies, and measurable benefits (e.g., SLA/TAT, productivity, quality, rework reduction, colleague experience).
  • Establish robust governance: cadence, decision forums, RAID discipline, and clear accountability from design through stabilization.

Lead execution into BAU at scale

  • Ensure changes are converted into stable BAU execution through clear procedures, training reinforcement, effective MI routines, and operational ownership.
  • Sponsor operational readiness and rollout discipline: go/no-go criteria, fallback arrangements, hyper care, and post-implementation performance tracking.
  • Drive standardization and reduce variation where it improves right-first-time outcomes and strengthens control integrity.

Strengthen risk management and continuously improve control effectiveness (end-to-end)

  • Proactively identify operational risks, control gaps, and emerging issues using MI, quality/error themes, incidents, audit/assurance feedback, colleague feedback, and journey breakpoints.
  • Lead timely remediation: ensure actions are owned, prioritized, tracked to closure with evidence, and translated into sustained BAU practices (not one-off fixes).
  • Review existing control design and drive enhancements to improve control effectiveness and efficiency, especially where processes are being digitized, simplified or re-shaped by AI-first operating model changes.
  • Ensure controls remain effective through change by embedding requirements into delivery: control points, evidence expectations, exception handling, auditability, and clear accountability across handoffs.
  • Partner with relevant risk and control stakeholders (Operations Risk, Compliance, second line where applicable) to assess change impacts, agree treatment plans, and ensure alignment to risk appetite and policy intent.
  • Strengthen preventative controls and “right-first-time” execution by addressing root causes through process design, clearer decisioning, better guidance, capability uplift, and improved tooling support.

Partner with Technology and change teams to embed automation/digitization safely

  • Provide senior operational leadership to shape and implement automation/digitization (e.g., workflow automation and AI-enabled assistance where applicable), ensuring solutions reflect real operational scenarios, exceptions, constraints, and control requirements.
  • Ensure operational testing and validation is rigorous (including edge cases) and that adoption mechanisms are in place so solutions are used effectively and safely in frontline operations.
  • Act as an escalation point to resolve trade-offs between speed, customer outcomes, risk/control requirements, and operational practicality.

Deliver simplification of process and policy (with clear risk alignment)

  • Lead identification and prioritization of simplification opportunities that reduce complexity, handoffs and rework while remaining aligned to policy intent and risk appetite.
  • Partner with policy/process owners and control stakeholders to land simplifications with documented rationale, approvals, and post-change assurance of control effectiveness.
  • Track and communicate simplification impact using clear measures (step reduction, cycle-time improvement, error reduction, fewer escalations/complaints where applicable).

Own MI, performance management, and benefits realization

  • Set expectations for MI quality and performance routines; ensure decision-making is grounded in facts (capacity, backlog drivers, SLA/TAT, quality/error trends, learning curve impacts).
  • Hold teams accountable for benefits realization and sustainability, driving corrective actions where outcomes drift post-implementation.
  • Provide clear, decision-oriented updates to senior stakeholders on progress, risks/issues, and outcomes.

Lead, develop, and motivate the Ops Support team

  • Directly manage Senior Managers/Ops Support leads; set clear objectives and coaching plans tied to operational outcomes, risk discipline and leadership behaviors.
  • Build capability across problem-solving, data/MI fluency, change landing, and control mindset.
  • Foster an inclusive, high-performance culture across the site, role-modelling HSBC values and collaboration.

Represent Ops Support in site and people governance

  • Actively lead and participate in site committees/initiatives (e.g., GPTW, Wellness, Risk, Customer Service, People), ensuring activities deliver tangible impact on engagement, capability and risk culture.

Requirements

  • 15+ years’ experience in banking operations / shared services / operational excellence / operations control leadership roles, with senior accountability for outcomes.

  • Ability to balance innovation with security, governance, resilience, delivery feasibility, and operational sustainability.

Strategic Engineering Leadership & Innovation

  • Define and execute the AI Engineering strategy to build and operate the Bank's AI Factory platform, enabling scalable delivery of AI, Machine Learning, Generative AI, and Agentic AI solutions.
  • Lead the engineering roadmap for enterprise AI capabilities including Model Hosting, RAG Platforms, Agent Frameworks, AI Workspaces, AI Lifecycle Services, and Developer Tooling.
  • Drive standardization, automation, and engineering best practices to accelerate AI solution delivery across the Bank.
  • Evaluate emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and engineering patterns to continuously improve platform capabilities and developer productivity.
  • Partner with Product, Architecture, and Business stakeholders to translate strategic objectives into scalable engineering solutions.

AI Platform Architecture & Engineering Delivery

  • Lead the architecture, design, development, and operation of secure, scalable, and resilient AI Factory platforms across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments.
  • Establish engineering standards, reference architectures, reusable frameworks, APIs, and development patterns for AI/ML, GenAI, RAG, and Agentic AI solutions.
  • Own end-to-end platform delivery, including infrastructure provisioning, AI development environments, model deployment, inference services, and platform operations.
  • Drive adoption of modern software engineering practices including CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, automated testing, release management, and platform automation.
  • Ensure platform scalability, availability, performance, reliability, and operational resilience through robust engineering and architecture practices.

Key Responsibilities

AI Operations, MLOps & Reliability Engineering

  • Establish and lead MLOps, LLMOps, and Platform Engineering capabilities covering model deployment, monitoring, observability, evaluation, performance optimization, and operational support.
  • Implement engineering controls for platform reliability, incident management, disaster recovery, capacity planning, and production support.
  • Drive engineering excellence through metrics, automation, telemetry, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Ensure AI platforms operate with appropriate service levels, support models, operational procedures, and recovery mechanisms.
  • Lead engineering readiness for enterprise-scale AI adoption through automation, self-service capabilities, and operational tooling.

Security, Controls & Engineering Risk Management

  • Embed security-by-design principles across AI Factory engineering processes and platform services.
  • Partner with Cyber Security (ICS), Infrastructure, Risk, and Architecture teams to ensure engineering solutions meet enterprise security and compliance requirements.
  • Implement technical controls supporting AI governance, data protection, access management, monitoring, and auditability requirements.
  • Drive remediation of engineering-related control gaps, vulnerabilities, technical debt, and operational risks.
  • Ensure responsible AI guardrails, monitoring solutions, and safety mechanisms are engineered into platform capabilities.

Stakeholder Management & Cross-Functional Delivery

  • Collaborate closely with Product Management, Architecture, Infrastructure, Data, Operations, Security, and Business teams to deliver enterprise AI capabilities.
  • Provide technical leadership and guidance for strategic AI programmes and large-scale engineering initiatives.
  • Support executive governance forums through engineering insights, delivery reporting, platform health metrics, and technology roadmaps.
  • Drive alignment across global engineering teams, ensuring consistent engineering standards, delivery practices, and operational processes.

People Leadership & Engineering Capability Development

  • Build, lead, and develop high-performing engineering teams across AI Engineering, Platform Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, and DevOps functions.
  • Foster a culture of engineering excellence, innovation, accountability, automation, and continuous learning.
  • Establish engineering career frameworks, succession plans, and talent development programmes.
  • Mentor senior engineers and engineering leaders while driving technical excellence across the organization.
  • Lead geographically distributed engineering teams and create a collaborative, high-performance engineering culture.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

  • TTO Management Team
  • T&A Management Team
  • CDO
  • Software Engineering Platform Teams
  • Business, Regional & Country CIOs & COOs
  • Operational, Technology & Cyber Risk
  • Chief Data Office
  • Group and Country Compliance & Regulators
  • Group Internal Audit
  • Group Operational Risk

Skills And Experience

  • Hands on with AI platform development and monitoring
  • Hands on with ML framework, best practices and ops implementation
  • Hands-on experience with GPU computing and optimization for AI workloads
  • Hands-on experience with design and implementation of sophisticated data catalogue
  • Programming languages such as Python, Java, or C++.

Qualifications

  • 15+ years of technology leadership experience in Software Engineering, AI/ML Platforms, Cloud Engineering, Distributed Systems, or Enterprise Technology organizations.
  • Proven experience leading large-scale engineering organizations responsible for building and operating enterprise platforms and products.
  • Deep expertise in AI Platform Engineering, Software Engineering, MLOps, LLMOps, Platform Operations, and Cloud-Native Architecture.
  • Demonstrated success building and operating enterprise AI platforms supporting Machine Learning, Generative AI, Agentic AI, and advanced analytics workloads at scale.
  • Strong hands-on understanding of distributed systems, microservices, API platforms, infrastructure automation, observability, reliability engineering, and platform security.
  • Experience designing and delivering enterprise AI capabilities including model hosting, RAG platforms, AI development environments, inference services, model lifecycle management, and reusable AI services.
  • Proven delivery of enterprise-grade platforms within highly regulated environments, with strong appreciation for security, resiliency, audit, and compliance requirements.
  • Experience implementing CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, DevSecOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), and modern software delivery practices.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity controls, identity and access management, operational resilience, and engineering risk management.
  • Proven ability to build, mentor, and scale high-performing engineering organizations across multiple regions.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management skills with experience influencing senior technology leaders, architects, risk functions, and executive stakeholders.
  • Experience leading global engineering teams delivering mission-critical technology platforms across multiple geographies and time zones.

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.

We are looking for a Quantitative Trader to join the Electronic Market Making team to develop market making models and manage associated risk for stocks and equity futures in Asia. The team is responsible for managing all quantitative market making activities for stocks and equity futures in Asia. This involves continuous quoting in multiple venues and providing block liquidity.

As a Quantitative Trader, you will play an integral role in expanding our business, monetizing our edge, and providing a superior service to our clients. We run a flat structure, and you will have ample opportunity to take responsibility from day one. Business: To maximize the revenues of customer portfolio and increase the Bank's share of customer wallets. To maintain a high level of credit quality in the jobholder's customer portfolio and to mitigate the hidden risks of the evolving Banking products.

  • Co-ordinate origination and execution of in country activities across the spectrum of banking products/service.
  • Build the Banking franchise value/reputation in the market place.
  • Drive achievement against targets for revenue generation, product alignment, customer satisfaction and cost containment.
  • Combine client relationship management with strong risk assessment and management capabilities ensuring the required credit quality & requisite returns on risk.
  • Identify event driven opportunities on an opportunistic basis, bringing in sector/country expertise as appropriate.
  • Aggressively grow HSBC's share of client wallet involving product specialists to ensure product capabilities are in line with client/sector requirements.
  • By critically assessing the exposures of each customer through vigorous review processes, active communications with CST members and frequent update of market intelligence. Such reviews are to be completed on time as required by the account review cycle and also where deemed necessary.
  • By working closely with Credit Risk Management to ensure that all credits are in compliance of both internal and external requirements and to formulate / implement exit or rehabilitation strategies for substandard credits. The primary goals are to safeguard the Bank for any material loss and to obtain an optimal balance between risk and return.

  • By ensuring customers' experiences with the Bank in all front exceed their expectations, i.e. first class services are provided promptly and professionally; solutions presented are competitive and innovative.
  • By keeping abreast of the customer's business development through frequent contacts in both official and social occasions.
  • By providing advisory-led value added services to customers with the jobholder's updated sector knowledge and market intelligence.
  • To assist senior bankers in ensuring focused relationship building programs are carried out regularly.

Leadership & Teamwork: To coordinate the CST to ensure the clients' needs are covered in a proactive and efficient manner. To support the senior bankers in operational issues.

  • By effectively utilizing customer relationship management tool (i.e. CME).
  • By managing client meetings and ensuring that product partners actively participate in discussions concerning client requirements and needs.

  • Demonstrate leadership on Regulatory & Compliance matters. Maintain awareness of operational risk and minimize the likelihood of it occurring including its identification, assessment, mitigation and control, loss identification and reporting.

Ability to provide marketing support to senior relationship managers

Ability to establish rapport with members of client's management team

Ability to provide good analytical support to senior relationship managers

Strong PC skills (excel, PowerPoint etc.)

Good team player

Knowledge of HSBC Group structures and products

Good level of financial analysis ability

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Tech SME.

Business: IWPB Technology

Principal Responsibilities

Principal responsibilities

Technical leadership and architecture

  • Own and communicate the technical vision, roadmap and engineering approach for Web Flows, aligned with Digital Platforms and wider iWPB Technology strategies.
  • Lead the design and delivery of secure, resilient and scalable web applications, APIs, microservices and associated platform components.
  • Translate complex business, customer and regulatory requirements into pragmatic technical solutions.
  • Work with Architecture, Platform Engineering, Cybersecurity and Infrastructure teams to agree solution designs, engineering standards and technology patterns.
  • Make informed technology decisions, balancing customer value, delivery speed, operational resilience, security, maintainability and cost.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify the technology estate, reduce technical debt and retire legacy components.
  • Ensure solutions are designed for availability, recoverability, observability, performance and efficient support.
  • Provide technical direction across multiple agile squads and ensure consistency of engineering practices across locations.

Engineering delivery

  • Lead the technical delivery of Web Flows initiatives from discovery and design through implementation, release and production support.
  • Break down complex or ambiguous problems into clear technical outcomes, deliverables and implementation plans.
  • Review and assure solution designs, code quality, test strategies, release plans and operational readiness.
  • Remove technical impediments and manage dependencies across teams, platforms and technology functions.
  • Support delivery teams in applying agile, DevSecOps and continuous delivery practices.
  • Promote automation across build, test, deployment, environment management and operational processes.
  • Ensure engineering deliverables meet agreed standards for quality, security, resilience, performance and regulatory compliance.
  • Contribute to planning, estimation, prioritisation and capacity discussions, ensuring that technology risks and dependencies are visible.

Platform resilience, security and operational effectiveness

  • Be accountable for the production readiness and operational health of Web Flows services.
  • Work with service management and production support teams to improve stability, incident prevention, monitoring and recovery processes.
  • Lead technical contributions to problem management, root-cause analysis and service improvement.
  • Ensure appropriate logging, monitoring, alerting, tracing and service-level measures are in place.
  • Identify and mitigate technology, cyber, operational and delivery risks.
  • Support audit, control assessments, risk reviews and independent programme assessments as required.
  • Ensure changes are delivered in accordance with HSBC’s control framework and technology policies.
  • Protect HSBC from avoidable operational, financial, regulatory and reputational risk.

Stakeholder management and influence

  • Build strong working relationships with Value Stream Leads, Product Owners, Architects, Engineering Leads, Operations, Cybersecurity and business stakeholders.
  • Represent Web Flows in relevant technology, delivery and governance forums.
  • Explain complex technical topics clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Influence decisions across teams and geographies without relying solely on formal authority.
  • Partner with third-party suppliers and technology vendors where applicable, ensuring delivery quality, value for money and effective risk management.
  • Contribute to the alignment of global, regional and local technology priorities.
  • Encourage constructive challenge and ensure diverse perspectives are considered in technical and delivery decisions.

People and engineering capability

  • Provide technical coaching, mentoring and day-to-day leadership to engineers and technical specialists.
  • Help build a high-performing, inclusive engineering culture focused on ownership, collaboration, quality and continuous improvement.
  • Share knowledge across teams and promote reuse of proven patterns, components and engineering practices.
  • Support capability development in modern web engineering, cloud technologies, automation, resilience, security and DevSecOps.
  • Identify skills gaps and contribute to development plans, communities of practice and technical learning.
  • Collaborate effectively with globally distributed colleagues and promote consistent ways of working across locations.
  • Demonstrate HSBC’s values by valuing difference, succeeding together, taking responsibility and getting it done.

Financial and delivery management

  • Support effective prioritisation of change and run activities within agreed budgets and delivery plans.
  • Ensure technical decisions consider total cost of ownership, operational efficiency and long-term sustainability.
  • Contribute to investment cases, delivery estimates, resource planning and vendor assessments.
  • Manage multiple priorities while maintaining focus on customer outcomes, engineering quality and risk management.

Requirements

Knowledge and experience / qualifications

Essential

  • Proven experience as a Tech Lead, Lead Engineer, Principal Engineer or equivalent role in a complex enterprise environment.
  • Strong experience designing and delivering web applications, digital journeys, APIs and distributed services at scale.
  • Demonstrable experience leading engineering delivery across multiple agile teams.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture, application design, data, infrastructure and integration patterns.
  • Experience with modern engineering practices, including DevSecOps, continuous integration and continuous delivery.
  • Experience with cloud technologies, containerisation, microservices and automated deployment approaches.
  • Strong understanding of non-functional requirements, including resilience, scalability, availability, performance, observability and security.
  • Experience working with architecture, cybersecurity, platform and operations functions to deliver production-ready services.
  • Ability to lead technical decision-making in situations involving ambiguity, competing priorities and complex dependencies.
  • Strong communication, influencing and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience coaching engineers and raising engineering standards across teams.
  • Experience working in a regulated industry or other environment with strong operational, security and control requirements.
  • Ability to work effectively with colleagues across multiple countries, cultures and time zones.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Conduct product training to support and deliver new product launches and lead client education events to help clients gain better knowledge of financial markets and financial solutions.
  • Follow the needs-based sales process, give clients meaningful and consistent wealth experience and ultimately provide an outstanding client experience
  • Support RMs to gain more client trust and commitment in broadening and deepening their relationship with HSBC, and increase the effectiveness and quality of needs fulfilled for target clients
  • Strengthen HSBC’s image as a leading wealth provider by providing clients with access to advanced technical product expertise
  • Conduct portfolio reviews with RMs, assess product suitability and market and regulatory change impact to products held by clients as appropriate, identify opportunities and manage risks
  • Join RMs in meeting clients and provide advice, input based on technical knowledge while acting as a second point of contact to RMs for specific products and solutions
  • Improve RMs product specific technical knowledge by effective on-job coaching and training
  • Activity: (Joint) meeting, Training, Coaching, Client Seminar, Portfolio Review, Policy Review
  • 提供新产品培训，帮助客户获得更好的理财市场信息和解决办法。
  • 根据客户财务需求，分享合适的财富管理经验和提供良好的客户体验
  • 帮助客户经理获得并加深客户信任，提高满足客户财务需求的有效性和质量
  • 利用先进的技术专长，加强客户对汇丰在财富管理市场上的领先形象
  • 帮助客户经理梳理客户财务组合，根据市场和政策变化，判断潜在机会并管理风险，对客户持有产品进行相应调整
  • 陪同客户经理约见客人，并基于产品和解决方法提供专业建议
  • 利用专长给客户经理提供辅导和培训
  • 活动包括客户会见及陪同销售、培训、辅导、客户沙龙、客户资产组合回顾及保单回顾等。

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Accumulated extensive working experience as a product specialist or financial advisor or hands-on working experience as Sub-branch Manager in IWPB
  • Strong client skills with the ability to deliver a strong client experience and provide needs-based solutions
  • Deep knowledge of specific complex financial solutions and products including the knowledge of financial markets, social-economic dynamics, and regulatory requirement relevant to the products
  • Extensive external market awareness of market conditions, new product solutions, and an understanding of current financial market activities
  • Demonstrated ability and experience to correctly identify client needs
  • Solid skills to manage consultative sales process
  • A solid understanding of global Anti-money Laundering standards
  • Team player with collaborative skills
  • Knowledge of local and Group compliance regulation
  • Specialization in one or more product categories e.g. /Estate Planning/Retirement/Protection/ Education.
  • 相关领域丰富的工作经验，如保险专家或财富管理专家,或有对私支行行长经验
  • 良好客户沟通能力，能基于客户需求提供建议
  • 熟悉财富管理相关产品知识以及相关政策规定
  • 熟悉外部市场包括市场环境，新产品推出以及对目前产品市场的理解
  • 能够深度挖掘客户需求
  • 熟悉销售流程
  • 熟悉国际反洗钱规则
  • 具有团队合作精神
  • 熟悉国际和国内相关法律规定
  • 在某一领域特别擅长优先，比如房地产规划/退休规划/家庭保障/教育规划等

Job Summary

App Development is responsible for designing, building, testing and maintaining secure, scalable and high-performing software solutions that support business, client and operational outcomes. The discipline translates business and technical requirements into reliable applications, services, interfaces and digital capabilities that can be safely operated, enhanced and scaled over time.

Operating across software engineering, API development, database integration, testing, secure coding, DevOps and production support, App Development plays a critical role in delivering technology that is maintainable, resilient and aligned to enterprise standards. The discipline requires strong programming capability, sound engineering judgement, collaboration across technology and business teams, and the ability to balance speed of delivery with quality, security, reliability and long-term sustainability.

Key Responsibilities

Solution Design & Application Development

  • Design and build software applications, interfaces, APIs and services that meet business requirements while remaining secure, scalable, maintainable and performant.
  • Translate functional and technical requirements into practical engineering solutions, selecting appropriate patterns, technologies and implementation approaches based on system context and delivery needs.
  • Develop and maintain application components across relevant technology stacks, which may include web, mobile, backend, integration, database or platform-specific environments.
  • Apply appropriate programming languages, frameworks and tools — such as Java, JavaScript, Python, Go, Kotlin, React, Angular, Android, HTML/CSS or equivalent technologies — where relevant to the application domain and platform context.

Code Quality, Testing & Engineering Standards

  • Write and maintain clean, readable, reusable and well-structured code that supports long-term maintainability and reduces avoidable technical debt.
  • Conduct and participate in code reviews to improve quality, consistency, security and adherence to engineering standards.
  • Develop and apply automated testing approaches, including unit, integration, API and regression testing, to strengthen delivery confidence and reduce defects.
  • Improve engineering practices by applying standards for version control, branching, documentation, peer review, test coverage and maintainable design.

Secure Development & Technology Risk

  • Implement secure coding practices to protect applications, data and customers from security vulnerabilities and technology risks.
  • Apply security fundamentals across application design and development, including authentication, authorisation, input validation, secrets management and secure API design where relevant.
  • Identify and remediate common application security issues, including web, mobile, API and data-related vulnerabilities.
  • Ensure development activities align with internal technology controls, software delivery standards and applicable governance requirements.

API, Integration & Data Engineering

  • Design and develop APIs, integration points and service interfaces that enable reliable data exchange between systems, platforms and digital channels.
  • Develop and optimise database structures, queries and data access patterns to support performance, scalability and reliability.
  • Apply database development and management practices across relevant database technologies, such as relational databases, MySQL or equivalent platforms, depending on application needs.
  • Support distributed system design by considering service boundaries, transaction handling, latency, resilience and dependency management.

DevOps, Deployment & Release Readiness

  • Support application deployment through CI/CD practices, automated build pipelines, version control and controlled release processes.
  • Collaborate with release, infrastructure and operations teams to ensure applications are deployment-ready and aligned to environment, configuration and operational requirements.
  • Use DevOps practices, containerisation or orchestration technologies — such as Docker, Kubernetes or equivalent platforms — where relevant to improve delivery consistency and application portability.
  • Prepare applications for production by ensuring appropriate configuration, documentation, operational handover and release readiness activities are completed.

Application Performance, Reliability & Supportability

  • Monitor and analyse application performance, errors, logs and operational metrics to identify reliability, scalability or user experience issues.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues across application code, APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure dependencies or runtime environments.
  • Design and improve applications with supportability in mind, including observability, logging, error handling, recovery behaviour and operational diagnostics.
  • Strengthen application resilience by identifying failure points, reducing recurring incidents and improving system behaviour under real-world operating conditions.

Technical Problem Solving & Continuous Improvement

  • Investigate and resolve complex technical problems using structured analysis, debugging, experimentation and collaboration with relevant specialists.
  • Evaluate new tools, frameworks and engineering approaches where they improve maintainability, security, scalability, developer productivity or delivery efficiency.
  • Simplify and refactor systems, code and workflows to reduce complexity, improve performance and address technical debt.
  • Apply lessons learned from defects, incidents, reviews and delivery challenges to improve future engineering outcomes.

Stakeholder Collaboration & Delivery Alignment

  • Collaborate with product owners, business stakeholders, designers, testers, release teams, infrastructure teams and other engineers to align solutions with user and business needs.
  • Communicate technical options, risks, dependencies and trade-offs clearly to support effective decision-making.
  • Contribute to agile delivery practices by participating in planning, refinement, estimation, reviews and continuous improvement activities.
  • Document technical designs, implementation decisions, interfaces and support information to enable maintainability, knowledge sharing and operational continuity.

Skills And Experience

Priority Skills

  • Software Engineering
  • Programming Principles
  • Application Programming Interface
  • Database Development
  • Distributed Systems
  • DevOps
  • Software Testing
  • Secure Coding
  • Web Application Security
  • Mobile Security

Other Skills

  • Platform Management
  • Operating Systems
  • Computer Network
  • Database Administration
  • Functional Writing

Motivations

  • Motivated by solving complex problems through technology and engineering creativity.
  • Energised by learning, experimenting and continuously improving technical solutions.
  • Thrives in collaborative environments where innovation, quality and craftsmanship are valued.

Qualifications

  • Experience contributing to the development of software solutions that support business, customer or operational outcomes.
  • Experience working in collaborative, cross-functional delivery teams where requirements are translated into technology solutions.
  • Experience applying structured problem-solving approaches to resolve technical challenges and improve system performance.
  • Experience working within engineering environments that emphasise quality, maintainability, security and continuous improvement.
  • Experience adapting to evolving technologies, development practices or delivery approaches while maintaining effective outcomes.
  • Business English

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced Assistant Vice President (AVP) Software Engineering Lead to join the COMPASS transformation program. The successful candidate will lead the design, development, and modernization of business-critical applications supporting Shareholder Services operations. This role combines hands-on software engineering, solution architecture, system integration, cloud-native development, and AI-driven engineering practices to accelerate delivery and improve operational efficiency throughout the software development lifecycle. COMPASS is the strategic platform supporting transaction workflows, integrations, operational processing, and the migration of legacy PRKS and Cash Portal capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

Software Engineering Leadership

  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-scale applications supporting COMPASS business capabilities.
  • Lead development activities across transaction processing, workflow orchestration, integrations, reporting, and operational services.
  • Drive software engineering best practices, code quality, DevOps, automated testing, and CI/CD adoption.
  • Mentor engineers and provide technical leadership across distributed global teams.


AI-Driven Engineering & Innovation

  • Apply Generative AI technologies to accelerate software development, testing, documentation, and production support activities.
  • Build AI-powered solutions to improve operational workflows, exception management, reconciliation processes, and business user experience.
  • Evaluate and implement AI services including Azure OpenAI, Copilot, LLMs, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Intelligent Agents, and AI-assisted automation.
  • Drive adoption of AI coding assistants, automated test generation, AI-based defect analysis, and engineering productivity solutions.


Architecture & Integration

  • Design scalable and resilient cloud-native solutions.
  • Lead integration development with internal and external platforms using APIs, file-based interfaces, messaging, and event-driven architectures.
  • Partner with Architecture, Infrastructure, Security, and Business teams to define target-state solutions.
  • Ensure application designs meet security, audit, resilience, and performance requirements.


Cloud & Platform Modernization

  • Support enterprise migration initiatives and cloud transformation programs.
  • Develop and deploy applications on AWS and Azure platforms.
  • Drive modernization of legacy systems into cloud-native architectures.
  • Implement observability, monitoring, and performance optimization solutions.


Delivery & Stakeholder Management

  • Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Business SMEs, Operations teams, and executive stakeholders.
  • Support COMPASS release planning, BUAT, system integration testing, production readiness, and platform rollout activities.
  • Provide technical leadership for strategic initiatives and executive-level deliverables.


Required Qualifications

Technical Skills

  • 5+ years of enterprise software development experience.
  • Strong Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, REST API development.
  • Experience with Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL optimization, and data integration solutions.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS and/or Azure cloud services.
  • CI/CD, GitHub, Jenkins, DevOps automation experience.
  • Strong system integration and distributed systems knowledge.
  • Experience building scalable enterprise applications.


AI / Machine Learning Skills

  • Experience using Generative AI tools in software development.
  • Understanding of LLMs, RAG frameworks, vector databases, prompt engineering, SDD and AI orchestration.
  • Experience with Github Copilot, Azure OpenAI, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent technologies.
  • Ability to identify and deliver AI use cases that improve engineering productivity and operational efficiency.


Leadership Skills

  • Experience leading development teams and mentoring engineers.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work with global teams across APAC, EMEA, and North America.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Shareholder Services, Investment Management, Transfer Agency, or Financial Services experience.
  • Experience with workflow platforms, transaction processing systems, or investment operations.
  • Knowledge of AI governance, responsible AI, and model risk controls.
  • Experience implementing Agentic AI solutions and enterprise automation platforms.
